gloss: to writhe, to suffer agony, to agonize

definitions.gloss: to writhe in pain, to suffer agony
definitions.explanation: To twist and turn one's body due to intense physical pain or emotional distress.
To suffer intense emotional distress such as frustration, longing, or jealousy.

examples.japanese: {苦|くる}しさに{悶|もだ}えながら{夜|よる}を{過|す}ごした。
examples.english: I spent the night writhing in agony.

examples.japanese: {腹痛|ふくつう}で{床|ゆか}に{倒|たお}れて{悶|もだ}えた。
examples.english: I collapsed on the floor writhing from stomach pain.

examples.japanese: {恋|こい}に{悶|もだ}える{若者|わかもの}
examples.english: a young person tormented by love

examples.japanese: {答|こた}えが{出|で}ない{問題|もんだい}に{悶|もだ}え{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: I kept agonizing over a problem with no answer.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}). Uses に particle for cause: {痛|いた}みに{悶|もだ}える.

CONJUGATION: Ichidan verb: {悶|もだ}えない, {悶|もだ}えます, {悶|もだ}えて, {悶|もだ}えれば.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {痛|いた}み/{苦|くる}しみに{悶|もだ}える (to writhe in pain/agony)
- {恋|こい}/{嫉妬|しっと}に{悶|もだ}える (to be tormented by love/jealousy)
- {悶|もだ}え{苦|くる}しむ (to suffer in agony - compound verb)

RELATED WORDS:
- {身悶|みもだ}える (to writhe - emphasizes whole body)
- {苦|くる}しむ (to suffer - more general)
- {悩|なや}む (to worry, be troubled - less intense)
